usedFor: flowyteam tracks goals, and Documint turns them into documents when “New Off-Track Key Result” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A key result going off track fills a Documint template, giving you a ready write-up to share.

watchOut: “New Check-in” fires on every saved check-in, so using it would fill the template again and again.
